name: au-racing-closing-lines-2026-09
title: Australian racing closing lines, September 2026
description: Opening and closing fixed win prices for Australian racing at TAB, Ladbrokes, PointsBet, BetRight and TABtouch, with results. One row per race, runner and bookmaker.

fields.name: race_id
fields.description: PuntersEdge race identifier. The same id the API returns on /v1/racing/results and /v1/racing/closing-lines.

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Advertised start time of the race, UTC.

fields.name: meeting_date_aet
fields.description: Racing day the meeting belongs to, in Australian Eastern time.

fields.name: venue
fields.description: Venue name.

fields.name: race_number
fields.description: Race number at the meeting.

fields.name: category
fields.description: horse (thoroughbred), harness or greyhound.

fields.name: country
fields.description: AU for every row in this sample.

fields.name: runner_key
fields.description: Runner name folded to lowercase letters and digits. Joins one runner's rows across bookmakers within a race.

fields.name: runner_name
fields.description: Runner name as published.

fields.name: runner_number
fields.description: Saddlecloth or rug number.

fields.name: bookmaker_key
fields.description: Bookmaker the prices were observed at: tab, ladbrokes_au, pointsbetau, betright or tabtouch, depending on the release.

fields.name: open_win_price
fields.description: First fixed win price observed in the series, in decimal odds.

fields.name: open_secs_to_jump
fields.description: Seconds before the advertised start at which the first price was observed.

fields.name: open_is_baseline
fields.description: True when the series began when the race entered the 60-minute capture window. False when the bookmaker's market appeared later, so the first price is not a market open.

fields.name: close_win_price
fields.description: Last fixed win price observed before the jump, in decimal odds. Every row in this sample was last observed within 300 seconds of the advertised start.

fields.name: close_secs_to_jump
fields.description: Seconds before the advertised start at which the last price was observed.

fields.name: points_observed
fields.description: Number of price observations captured in the series.

fields.name: finish_position
fields.description: Official finishing position where one was published. NULL does not mean the runner lost: harness results name the placegetters only, and before 14 September 2026 thoroughbred and greyhound results stored positions 1 to 4 only.

fields.name: result_status
fields.description: final, interim or abandoned; NULL when no result is held for the race.

fields.name: venue_id
fields.description: Stable PuntersEdge venue identifier.

fields.name: horse_ref
fields.description: Thoroughbred identity across meetings: pe: followed by the registered name folded to letters and digits. NULL on greyhound and harness rows.

fields.name: open_place_price
fields.description: Place price at the first observation. Captured from 29 September 2026, NULL before then and at bookmakers that price win only.

fields.name: close_place_price
fields.description: Place price at the last observation. Same coverage as open_place_price.
